close_reason: Won't fix: test-layer epoch math is self-contained in test code; production and test serve different purposes; both independently tested
description: common/mod.rs try_rfc3339_to_epoch_secs (lines 1565-1583) implements leap-year and days-since-epoch arithmetic from scratch. jmap-server/src/helpers.rs civil_from_days (lines 71-83) implements the same calendar logic using the Hinnant algorithm, also from scratch. The two implementations are independent and not cross-tested against each other. A divergence in edge cases (e.g. year 2000 leap day, negative epoch) would produce silent sort misordering. Suggested rewrite: expose civil_from_days from jmap-server as pub(crate) or move the epoch-arithmetic into jmap-types so both paths share one implementation with one set of test vectors.
title: rfc3339 epoch arithmetic duplicated between test backend and production
